message.content:
The value of $20 in British pounds depends on the current exchange rate, which fluctuates daily. As a rough estimate based on recent rates (about 1 USD ≈ 0.78 GBP), $20 would be roughly **£15.60**.  

For an exact amount, you’ll want to check a reliable financial source or a currency‑conversion tool at the time of your transaction.

There's no function for currency conversion. So we should respond with approximate conversion and mention that rates fluctuate. Provide an estimate. Use approximate rate: 1 USD ~ 0.78 GBP (as of recent). So 20 USD ~ £15.60. But we can say approximate. Also mention to check latest rates.
